title: Seacrest Residence | KEY.co
description_expanded: Each bedroom is designed with comfort and entertainment in mind, featuring smart TVs and plush bedding. The primary bedroom boasts a king bed and an en suite bathroom, the second bedroom offers a queen bed with an en suite bathroom, and the third bedroom features two bunk beds, perfect for children. The condo also includes a laundry room with a full-size washer and dryer and complimentary high-speed Wi-Fi for added convenience. With easy access to the pool and the charm of Seacrest at your doorstep, Villas at Seacrest B201 ensures a memorable and delightful stay. Villas at Seacrest poolside condo rental B201, located in the picturesque Seacrest, Florida, offers a luxurious retreat with all the conveniences of home. This three-bedroom, three-bathroom vacation haven promises an unforgettable experience, complete with a complimentary round of golf each day. The spacious living area provides a perfect spot to unwind, while the fully equipped kitchen with a breakfast bar and dining area invites memorable meals. Step out onto the balcony, where ample seating and a pool view create an ideal setting for relaxation and enjoyment.
